en.name: Baby food dinners
en.summary: Baby dinners are mixed meals — chicken, beef or turkey with vegetables and a starch such as rice or pasta. Meat plus cooked starch at low acidity is the shortest-lived thing in a baby's cupboard once it is open: 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, and only if no used spoon has been in the container. Sealed, discard after the use-by date printed on the jar or pouch.
en.pantry: Sealed, these are commercially sterilised and sit on the shelf to the printed date; there is no number of ours to add, because that date is the maker's statement about their own product. Store them cool and dark, and inspect before opening — a vacuum button that clicks, a swollen pouch, a rusty ring around a jar lid. Once open, nothing about a dinner belongs at room temperature, and the specific mistake to avoid is warming one in a bottle warmer and then leaving it sitting there: meat and cooked starch held lukewarm is exactly what Bacillus cereus and Clostridium perfringens multiply in.
en.fridge: Two days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, which is the shortest window on this site and deliberately so. There is meat or poultry in the jar, the whole mixture is low in acid, and the person eating it has an immune system that is still being built. Thick and savoury, a dinner also hides spoilage better than a fruit purée does, so do not lean on smell. Feed from a bowl, never from the jar with a spoon that has been in the baby's mouth, because saliva puts bacteria and digestive enzymes straight into the remainder. Reheat a refrigerated portion right through to steaming, 74 °C (165 °F), and only once.
en.freezer: There is no published freezer figure for an opened baby dinner, and no number should be borrowed from another food to fill the gap. Commercial jars and pouches are not built to be frozen and reheated: the sauce splits, the starch goes grainy and the meat turns fibrous. Dinners you have cooked and cooled yourself do freeze sensibly in single portions — label each one with what it is as well as the date, since a frozen cube of chicken and carrot looks exactly like a frozen cube of beef and pea. Never refreeze a portion that has been thawed and warmed.
en.thawing: Thaw a home-made portion in the fridge overnight, never on the counter, and heat it through once until it steams. Stir it and check the temperature on your wrist afterwards, because meat and starch heat unevenly and the middle can be scalding while the edge feels merely warm.
spoilage: A lid that clicks when pressed, or a swollen or leaking pouch — do not open it, discard it.
Any bubbling, spurting or hissing when the jar is opened.
A sour or off smell, or a colour that has darkened.
Mould anywhere around the rim or under the lid.
tips: Spoon a portion into a bowl; never feed from the jar with a used spoon.
Write the time and date you opened it on the jar.
Check the vacuum button on every new jar before opening.
Never give honey to a baby under one year old — it can carry the spores that cause infant botulism.

faq.q: How long does an opened jar of baby dinner keep?
faq.a: 2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, and only if it has never been fed from directly.

faq.q: Why can't you keep food you have fed from?
faq.a: Saliva from the spoon carries bacteria and enzymes into the remaining food, which then spoils quickly. Always spoon a portion into a bowl and feed from that.

faq.q: Can you freeze baby dinners from a jar?
faq.a: No timeline is published for it, and commercial jars separate badly when frozen and reheated. Freezing your own purées in an ice cube tray is a better approach.

zh.name: 嬰兒主餐副食品
zh.summary: 嬰兒主餐副食品是混合餐——雞肉、牛肉或火雞肉配蔬菜，再加米飯、麵這類澱粉。肉加上煮過的澱粉、又是低酸，開封後就是寶寶櫥櫃裡最短命的東西：蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天，而且前提是沒有用餵過的湯匙挖過。未開封的，過了罐子或軟袋上印的有效日期就丟。
zh.pantry: 未開封的經過商業滅菌，可以放到包裝上印的日期為止；我們沒有自己的數字要補，因為那個日期就是廠商對自家產品的說法。請收在陰涼避光處，開封前先檢查：真空鈕會彈、軟袋鼓脹、罐蓋邊緣生鏽的都不要用。一旦開封，主餐沒有任何一部分適合待在室溫，而最該避免的具體錯誤是：放進溫奶器加熱後就一直擺在那裡——肉和煮過的澱粉維持在不冷不熱的溫度，正是仙人掌桿菌和產氣莢膜梭菌繁殖的條件。
zh.fridge: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下 2 天，這是全站最短的一類期限，而且是刻意的。罐子裡有肉或禽肉，整體又是低酸，吃它的人免疫系統還在建構中。主餐濃稠、味道偏鹹香，也比果泥更會藏住壞掉的跡象，所以不要只靠鼻子判斷。請從碗裡餵，不要拿進過寶寶嘴巴的湯匙直接挖罐子，因為口水會把細菌和消化酵素直接送進剩下的那一份。冷藏過的份量要復熱到冒蒸氣、達到 74 °C 以上，而且只復熱一次。
zh.freezer: 開封後的嬰兒主餐沒有公布的冷凍天數，也不該從別的食物借一個數字來填。市售玻璃罐和軟袋本來就不是設計成冷凍再復熱的：醬汁會分離、澱粉變粗、肉變柴。自己煮好放涼的主餐則可以合理地分成單次份量冷凍——每一份都要寫清楚是什麼、哪一天做的，因為凍成方塊的雞肉紅蘿蔔和牛肉豌豆長得一模一樣。解凍加熱過的那一份，絕對不要再冷凍。
zh.thawing: 自製的份量放冷藏解凍一晚，絕對不要放檯面，加熱一次、熱到冒蒸氣。之後攪拌均勻並在手腕內側試溫，因為肉和澱粉受熱不均，邊緣摸起來溫溫的時候，中心可能已經燙嘴。
spoilage: 瓶蓋真空鈕按下去會響，或軟袋鼓脹、滲漏——不要打開，直接丟掉。
打開時有冒泡、噴濺或嘶嘶聲。
聞起來發酸或有異味，或顏色明顯變深。
瓶口或蓋子內側出現霉。
tips: 舀一份到碗裡；絕對不要用餵過的湯匙直接從罐子裡挖。
在罐子上寫下開封的日期和時間。
每一罐開封前都先檢查真空鈕。
未滿一歲的寶寶絕對不能吃蜂蜜——它可能帶有引起嬰兒肉毒桿菌中毒的孢子。

faq.q: 開封的嬰兒主餐可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋好放 4 °C 以下冷藏 2 天，而且前提是從來沒有直接從裡面餵過。

faq.q: 為什麼餵過的就不能留？
faq.a: 湯匙上的口水會把細菌和酵素帶進剩下的食物，那一份就會很快壞掉。請一律舀到碗裡，從碗裡餵。

faq.q: 市售嬰兒主餐可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 它沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且市售罐頭冷凍再復熱後質地會嚴重分離。自己做的泥用製冰盒冷凍是比較好的做法。

faq.q: 用電鍋把嬰兒主餐蒸熱，沒吃完可以留到下一餐嗎？
faq.a: 不能。只要餵過就整份丟掉，跟有沒有蒸過無關——湯匙帶進去的口水、細菌和酵素不會因為加熱就一筆勾銷。沒餵過、只是舀出來蒸熱的那一份，也不要再倒回原罐冰回去。主餐泥含肉或家禽，是低酸的混合食品，開封後在 4 °C 以下也只有 2 天。實際的做法是一開始就只舀這一餐要吃的量，蒸熱後裝到碗裡餵，罐子蓋好立刻冰回冰箱，不要讓它擱在電鍋旁邊慢慢放涼。
